name: Ayase Yuzuha
source:
A teacher at Shunbayashi Gakuen who is in charge of Akisuke's class.
She is enthusiastic about her work and is proud of her teacher's work. However, since her career is still short and her personality is unreliable, it is hard to say that she is in full control of the class (and students) she is in charge of. Raised as a young lady, she is a little naïve. I grew up without knowing the hardships that seemed to be hard work, so I am also mentally weak. Maternal personality. The owner has an atmosphere that seems to wrap up gently.

[from Getchu]
